title: Austin Tax Collection and Delinquent Debt Suits
summary:
• **Hired outside attorney**: The city council approved hiring Kyrie Thrasher as a special agent to pursue tax collection lawsuits against delinquent taxpayers, including receivers James H Hart and Joe Koen, for unpaid taxes from the current and previous years.

• **Approved tax rolls**: Council formally approved the 1907 city tax assessment rolls, including all supplemental assessments made through February 10, 1908.

• **One alderman excused**: Alderman Petri was excused from the meeting due to illness, while other absent members were called to appear.

Called meeting of the City Council,Austin,Texas,February 10, 1908: Hon F M
Maddox,Mayor,Presiding: Roll called; Present Aldermen:
Armstrong,Crooker,Haynes,Meredith,Miller,Moreland, Redd,Smith & Wilhelm 9 Absent Aldermen
Cuneo,Moore,Petri,Scott & Sutor 5 Alderman Crooker moved a call of the council,which was
seconded and the Marshal directed to bring in the absentees. On motion Alderman Petri was
excused on account of sickness; Alderman Scott entered the Council chamber and answered to
his name; On motion the call was Suspended .
The following call of the Council was read.

Call Council Austin,Texas , February 10,1908 .
A special meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin is hereby called to meet in
the Council chamber,City Hall building,at 5,30 oclock P M this the 10th day of
February,1908,for the following purposes,viz: 1 . To consider and enter into a contract
with Kyrie Thrasher whereby the said Thrasher is to bring for the City of Austin,in the
name of the City,tax suits against James H Hart ,Receiver,and Joe Koen,Receiver,and such
other parties as may be necessary to such litigation for delinquent taxes due the City for
the current and certain past years.
2 . To consider and approve certain supplemental tax rolls of the City Collector and
Assessor of taxes,and any other action necessary thereunder .

F M Maddox,Mayor of the City of A
Austin,Tom D Smith,L M Crooker,H L Haynes,W C Redd, C J Wilhelm, Henry Petri, J M Meredith

Ordinance D umpia
Instructing Mayor
To employ Ky
By Alderman Haynes an ordinance authorizing and instructing the Mayor of the City of
Austin to employ Kyrie Thrasher as agent and attorney of of the City of Austin for the
purpose of causing the assessment and collection of certain taxes due said City.
The ordinance was read the first time and passed under suspension of the rules by the
following vote : Yeas Aldermen
Armstrong,Crooker,Haynes,Meredith,Miller,Moreland,Redd,Scott, Smith & Wilhelm 10
Nays none.
1908. Feb. 10. Alderman Scott offered the following resolution which was read and adopted;
Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin That the City Tax rolls of 1907
be and is hereby approved including all supplemental assessments made thereto up to &
including the 10th day of Feby 1908 .
On motion the Council adjourned .

Jno. Johnson
City Clerk
